```artifact
Feature: Virtual Clinic Management System

  Scenario: User Login
    Given a valid login id/username and password
    When the user attempts to log in
    Then the system should grant access

  Scenario: Administrator Login
    Given a valid administrator login id/username and password
    When the administrator attempts to log in
    Then the system should grant access

  Scenario: Maintain Speciality
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Maintain Speciality menu
    Then the system should display the Maintain Speciality screen

  Scenario: Maintain Doctors
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Maintain Doctors menu
    Then the system should display the Maintain Doctors screen

  Scenario: Maintain Chemist & Labs
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Maintain Chemist & Labs menu
    Then the system should display the Maintain Chemist & Labs screen

  Scenario: Maintain Symptoms
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Maintain Symptoms menu
    Then the system should display the Maintain Symptoms screen

  Scenario: Set-up Users/ Passwords
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Set-up Users/ Passwords menu
    Then the system should display the Set-up Users/ Passwords screen

  Scenario: Set-up Control File (for Pincode)
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Set-up Control File (for Pincode) menu
    Then the system should display the Set-up Control File (for Pincode) screen

  Scenario: Create Appointment File
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Create Appointment File menu
    Then the system should display the Create Appointment File screen

  Scenario: View/ Print Invoice
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the View/ Print Invoice menu
    Then the system should display the View/ Print Invoice screen

  Scenario: Back-ups
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Back-ups menu
    Then the system should display the Back-ups screen

  Scenario: Archive Patient Profiles
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Archive Patient Profiles menu
    Then the system should display the Archive Patient Profiles screen

  Scenario: Create Users - Doctor(s)
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Create Users menu and selects Doctors
    Then the system should display the Create Users - Doctor(s) screen

  Scenario: Create Users - Chemists and Labs
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Create Users menu and selects Chemists and Labs
    Then the system should display the Create Users - Chemists and Labs screen

  Scenario: Maintain Speciality - Add Speciality
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Maintain Speciality menu and selects Add Speciality
    Then the system should display the Add Speciality screen

  Scenario: Maintain Speciality - Edit/Update Speciality
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Maintain Speciality menu and selects Edit/Update Speciality
    Then the system should display the Edit/Update Speciality screen

  Scenario Outline: Add Speciality Screen - Speciality Id, Speciality Name, Speciality Description
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Add Speciality screen
    And the administrator enters the following values:
      | Speciality Id | Speciality Name | Speciality Description |
      | <speciality_id> | <speciality_name> | <speciality_description> |
    Then the system should display the Speciality added successfully message

    Examples:
      | speciality_id | speciality_name | speciality_description |
      | 1             | Cardiology      | Treatment of heart diseases |
      | 2             | Dermatology     | Treatment of skin diseases |
      | 3             | Neurology       | Treatment of nervous system diseases |

  Scenario Outline: Edit/ Update Speciality Screen - Query on Speciality Id, Speciality Name, Speciality Description
    Given the administrator is logged in
    When the administrator navigates to the Edit/ Update Speciality screen
    And the administrator enters the following values:
      | Speciality Id | Speciality Name | Speciality Description |
      | <speciality_id> | <speciality_name> | <speciality_description> |
    Then the system should display the Speciality updated successfully message

    Examples:
      | speciality_id | speciality_name | speciality_description |
      | 1             | Cardiology      | Updated treatment of heart diseases |
      | 2             | Dermatology     | Updated treatment of skin diseases |
      | 3             | Neurology       | Updated treatment of nervous system diseases |
```
